## About these materials

::: {.callout-warning collapse="true"}
## Citation statement
Please cite these materials as: Von Grebmer zu Wolfsthurn, S., Edelsbrunner, P., Ihle, M., & Schönbrodt, F. (2026). *Introduction to version control with Git in RStudio* [Quarto slides]. [LMU Open Science Center](https://www.osc.lmu.de/). [https://lmu-osc.github.io/teaching-material-for-novices/open-research-tools/git](https://lmu-osc.github.io/teaching-material-for-novices/open-research-tools/git)
:::

**Welcome!** This workshop is intended with a foundational **understanding of version control** and practical skills to **apply version control** to their own workflows. Here, we will learn about tools that can help us increase the transparency of our work to ourselves and the people we work with, by **tracking the changes we make** to our work in a systematic manner. This way, others (and our future selves) can follow the steps and decision making process. 

::: {.callout-important}
## Longer delivery time for these materials
In contrast to other materials, the estimate delivery time for these materials is approximately **3 hours**. If you have a shorter lesson slot, you can find a proposed lesson plan in the instructor notes in the slides.
:::

### Who are these materials for?

- **Educators** in higher education with or without familiarity with open research planning to **teach open research novices**
- **Self-learners** with no or limited familiarity with open research planning to **develop and build** up on their open research skills

<div style="font-size: 0.8em;">
| Prerequisite   |  Description  | Link/Where to find it   |
|------------|------------|------------|
| Laptop/PC with internet access | Admin rights for downloading/installing software | - |
| R and RStudio installed | Latest versions of both R and RStudio |  [https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop/](https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop/) |
| Basic R skills | Introduction to R - Part I | [Access here]() |
| Advanced R skills | Introduction to R - Part II | [Access here]()  |
| GitHub account | Your own GitHub account | Join at [https://github.com/join](https://github.com/join) |
</div>

### Learning objectives

At the end of this session, you or your learners will be able to ...

- **Understand** the problem(s) that can be solved by version control
- **Install** and **configure** Git 
- **Set up** the connection between your computer and GitHub
- **Create** an RStudio Project under version control for a reproducible workflow
- **Make** changes within RStudio and **commit** changes locally
- **Connect** local and remote repositories for your work
